'''2014 Philadelphia Premiere Anthony Natale DS Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Anthony Natale]] at [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]].

* '''Player:''' [[Anthony Natale]]
